snippet.title: Darkwood 2 - Announcement Trailer | Survival Horror Game
snippet.description:
Set merely a few years after the events of the critically acclaimed survival horror game Darkwood, the sequel brings with it new lands and waters to explore, new creatures to fear, and new reasons to pray for the morning light.
